title: This is why / That is why
titleZh: 「This is why / That is why」表達原因與結果
titleEn: Using This is why / That is why to connect reason and result

source.file: Sentence Structure 180 -「This is why _ That is why」表達原因與結果.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Reason or situation. This is why + subject + verb + result

formulas.formula: Reason or situation. This is why + subject + verb + result
Earlier or previously mentioned reason. That is why + subject + verb + result

example: People need clear leadership. This is why communication matters so much.
exampleZh: 人們需要清晰的領導。這就是為甚麼溝通如此重要。

examples.en: People need clear leadership. This is why communication matters so much.
examples.zh: 人們需要清晰的領導。這就是為甚麼溝通如此重要。
examples.highlight: People need clear leadership. This is why communication matters so much.

examples.en: The team lacked trust. That is why the project moved slowly.
examples.zh: 團隊缺乏信任。那就是為甚麼項目進展緩慢。
examples.highlight: The team lacked trust. That is why the project moved slowly.

rules.zh: 原因放在前面，結果放在後面 第一句先交代原因或情況，第二句才使用 This is why 或 That is why 引出結果。 （道路水浸。那就是為甚麼巴士停止行駛。）
rules.en: Place the reason first and the result second. The first sentence states the cause or situation; the second uses This is why or That is why to introduce the result: The roads were flooded. That is why the buses stopped running.
examples: The roads were flooded. That is why the buses stopped running.

rules.zh: why 後面必須接完整句子 This is why / That is why 後面應接「主語＋動詞」。
rules.en: Why must be followed by a complete clause with a subject and verb. Write This is why the shop is closed, not This is why the shop's closure.
examples: This is why the shop is closed.
This is why the shop’s closure.

rules.zh: This 和 That 的分別 This is why 通常指向剛剛提出、與目前情況較接近的原因。 （房間需要更多光線。這就是為甚麼我們正在拉開窗簾。） That is why 通常回指較早發生或已經提及的事情。 （火車誤點。那就是為甚麼里奧遲到了。） 在很多日常情況中，兩者都可以成立；以上分別主要反映說話者如何看待前面的原因。
rules.en: Choose This or That according to the reference. This is why normally points to a reason just mentioned or felt to be close to the current situation: The room needs more light. This is why we are opening the curtains. That is why normally refers back to something earlier or already mentioned: The train was delayed. That is why Leo arrived late. In many everyday contexts either is possible; the distinction mainly reflects how the speaker views the preceding reason.
examples: The room needs more light. This is why we are opening the curtains.
The train was delayed. That is why Leo arrived late.

rules.zh: 不要在 why 後面再加 because
rules.en: Do not add because after why. Write The road was closed. This is why we took another route, not This is why because the road was closed.
examples: This is why because the road was closed.
The road was closed. This is why we took another route.

rules.zh: 本課使用兩個完整句子 本練習的目標是： 以下的單句形式不屬於本課目標：
rules.en: Use two complete sentences in this lesson: The system was too slow. This is why we replaced it. The single-sentence form The system was too slow, which is why we replaced it is grammatical but is not the target pattern here.
examples: The system was too slow. This is why we replaced it.
The system was too slow, which is why we replaced it.

rules.zh: 保留原句的時態和意思 改寫時，不要改變人物、動作、時間、否定意思或事情的嚴重程度。
rules.en: Preserve the original tense and meaning. During rewriting, do not change the people, actions, time, negative meaning or severity of the situation.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示原因與結果 這個句型把原因和結果分成兩個清楚步驟，讀者能立即明白兩者的關係。 （路面結冰。那就是為甚麼司機減速。）
benefits.en: It makes cause and result very clear by presenting them in two distinct steps, so the reader immediately understands their relationship: The road was icy. That is why the driver slowed down.
examples: The road was icy. That is why the driver slowed down.

benefits.zh: 幫助你有條理地解釋事情 你可以先完整交代背景，再說明結果。即使原因比較長，句子仍然容易理解。
benefits.en: It helps you organise an explanation. You can present the full background first and then state the result, so the explanation remains easy to follow even when the reason is long.

benefits.zh: 突出事情產生的結果 This is why 和 That is why 會提醒讀者：「接下來就是前面情況所造成的結果。」
benefits.en: It gives extra attention to the result. This is why and That is why signal to the reader that the next information is the consequence of the preceding situation.

benefits.zh: 避免反覆使用 because 和 so 兩句意思相近，但第二種寫法能改變句子的組織方式，令說話和寫作不會過分重複。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to because and so Compare: The team moved slowly because it lacked trust. The team lacked trust. That is why it moved slowly.
examples: The team moved slowly because it lacked trust.
The team lacked trust. That is why it moved slowly.

benefits.zh: 適合口語、作文和簡報 當你需要解釋決定、問題、行為或結果時，這個句型能提供一個容易掌握的表達框架。
benefits.en: It is useful in speaking, essays and presentations. When explaining a decision, problem, behaviour or result, the pattern provides an easy-to-use organisational frame.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
